column2: You know, not everyone in the labyrinth is an enemy.
Huh? Not enemies? So, what, friends?
Yup! Mr. Vampire and Mr. Wizard aren't enemies. And neither are my friends!
Once the miasma's gone, they're all really nice people!
So if I destroy the bordermoons...?
They might be willing to help you out.
They'll give you hints and sell you dress materials.
That's all I came to say. Bye-bye!
But right now, I'm more curious about Father's research.
Let's see... The study, maybe? I might find something there. I'd better head back to the manor.
I could just keep going, but...
No, no. It's still bothering me. To the study!
No. Haste makes waste, as they say.
Don't rush it. I should look around more carefully first.
Thanks for stopping by! Make yourself at home.
Thanks for stopping by! Make yourself at home.
No. I have to find out what it is. The genomroid!
Right. Let's hurry down to the basement laboratory.
No. I need to ask Mikhail about the genomroid!
Thanks for stopping by! Make yourself at home.
I've got some rare goods in stock, too. Do have a look.
Well, what do you want me to say?
What I don't know, I don't know.
I recall hearing someone was selling a rare book.
If memory serves, it was on B26F...
Why not go and see for yourself?
Thanks for stopping by! Make yourself at home.
Hang on just a little longer! I'll save you, I promise!
B-but... I think... I'm at my limit too...
Okay then. Let's see what I can find.
Sorry, Father, but I think I'll read just a little.
I need every clue I can get right now. Forgive me, Father.
Though to be honest, reading someone else's diary is kind of fun.
Hehehe. Here goes. Let's see now...
Today I went out with my daughter.
When was the last time I saw her so happy?
Today I played with my daughter.
Watching her face change from moment to moment, I felt a quiet happiness.
These happy days pass so gently. If only they could last forever...
Father... You really cared about me that much?
Unrest is spreading even here in Russia.
We are safe for now, but sooner or later...
There seems to be no stopping the tide of the times.
Something terrible is bound to happen before long.
Today, again, many people fought and died.
At this rate, we will be in danger too. I must find some way out...
Oh, come on! Just when it was getting good!
Hmm. Doesn't look like it's in here.
If it's anywhere, maybe Father's bedroom? Should I go check?
Still, I never knew Father was Russian.
But wait... I don't remember anything about living in Russia.
It's no use. I just can't remember.
Sigh. Oh well. I'll worry about it later.
First things first. I need to find out more about Father.
Milady, please don't do anything so reckless.
Oh, that's right. I was attacked by a monster in the labyrinth...
Please don't worry me like that.
Please be more careful from now on.
I will. By the way, Mikhail...
Did you just smack me awake?
W-well, er... You just wouldn't wake up, so...
Fine, whatever. But you'll pay for this later.
Oh, right. I went and did it again, didn't I?
After I told you over and over to be careful, and you still...!
I-I know, okay? I'll be careful next time, so can we drop it?
Good grief, there's no helping it. Please do be careful.
Oh my, Miss? What brings you here?
Don't tell me you've given up on the professor?
Heheh. After all, your own life matters more, doesn't it?
Then why not get going? You'll be too late, you know.
Not that it matters to me either way. Kekekeke.
Miss? What are you doing here?
If you have time to loaf around here, why not get going already?
If you don't hurry, the professor is sure to... Kekeke.
And please stop laughing like that. It's creepy.
How rude. Do you have a problem with me?
Well? Don't just stand there, off you go. The professor is waiting, you know.
Don't say a word. I'm just glad you're safe.
This place is dangerous. Come, let's get out of here.
Hm? Where are you going, Alice?
I'm going to go defeat Varuudanu again!
What? You've done enough. There's no need to push yourself any further!
Even if we run, we'll never get away! So I'm going to it! I'll go and beat it!
I see. Very well, I won't stop you. Go, Alice.
Even with the holy sword, a head-on attack won't leave a scratch on it.
The shoulder! Aim for its shoulder! There, surely...!
Got it, Father! I'll give it a try!
So you're going after all? To face it once more?
I see. Then go. And be sure to come back.
I've got the bible. Now I need to find the other one, fast.
But where am I supposed to make a dress?
It seems there are countless sewing rooms throughout this labyrinth.
Huh? Really? And? Can I actually use those sewing machines?
Yes. I checked earlier, and they should work just fine...
Now, milady! Use that holy sword to rescue the professor!
Right, I know! Leave it to me!
O Lord, grant this girl the strength to live once more.
O Lord, descend from the heavens on high and reveal Thy power.
Oh, that's right. Back then, I...
The revival ritual was in time on this occasion, but...
There's no guarantee it'll go so well next time!
I won't stop you, but please be more careful from now on!
Now then, take care, milady. And do be careful this time.
O Lord, O Heaven, grant this girl the strength to live once more.
O Lord, O Earth, reveal Thy boundless power here and now.
Thank goodness. You've come to safely.
Oh, I went and did it again, didn't I?
After I told you over and over to be careful, and you still...!
Don't shout. I'll be careful next time, so can we drop it?
Sigh. There's no helping it. Please do be careful this time.
I know, I know! Well, I'm off.
